title: 重命名版式
description: Rail tools for the layout being edited: 重命名 opens a name field (24 characters at most). An empty name is refused in the editor with 版式名称不能为空 and sends nothing.

kimiUi.location: 左侧「母版与版式」列表，当前版式下方
kimiUi.appearsWhen: on a layout surface (not the master)

preconditions.notes: Entered first with 编辑版式 on page 5 (正文).

steps: 名称为空时显示「版式名称不能为空」，不发送命令

pptd.summary: layoutRename changes the layout's name in the PPTD document

selfTestChecklist: rename refuses an empty name, then sends the new one
